welcome:
MiniOS CLI Shell v2.0 (x86_64-apple-darwin)
Type 'help' or 'minios' for command assistance.
help_output:
Available MiniOS Terminal commands:
  minios      Display MiniOS system specifications info
  whoami        Display active username
  uname         Display system and kernel version
  pwd           Display current working directory
  date          Display current system date and time
  ls            List files & folders in storage directory
  artisan       Execute Artisan commands (e.g. artisan inspire, artisan about)
  echo [text]   Print text to the screen
  clear         Clear the terminal screen
command_not_found: command not found: :cmd. Type 'help' for command list.
permission_denied: ls: Permission denied (Guest user). Please log in to MiniOS first.
artisan_restricted: MiniOS Security: Command 'artisan :cmd' is restricted in Web Terminal. Allowed commands: :allowed
